These JSON fixtures are a reduced selection of the official Vesteria Database responses captured on 15 November 2026. The map viewer geometry is omitted, and the catalog contains only assets relevant to the tests. Response values otherwise retain the captured data; tests do not require network access or Discord credentials.

Game information is provided by Vesteria, Inc. under the [Vesteria Content License](https://db.playvesteria.com/content-license). These fixtures are test data, not current game information.
